name: capability_denied_returns_code_1001
description: Calling a tool whose required_capabilities aren't granted returns Response::Error { code: 1001, retryable: false }. Requires the target server to expose a capability-gated tool — the atd reference server does this via `ref:conformance.denied_op` (registered when `--enable-conformance-tool` is passed). Third-party servers that want to validate this case must expose a tool with id `ref:conformance.denied_op` requiring capability `conformance.denied` (and NOT grant that cap by default).
